description:
Huge thanks to the 1 Billion Followers Summit, Mohammed Bin Rashid Global Initiatives, and the Varkey Foundation; the partners who believed in this vision and helped make this village a reality.

Click the link to claim your free Neuro Gum Pack, valued up to $24, at Costco or Walmart here: https://try.gotoaisle.com/neuro-beast

With gratitude to The Rockefeller Foundation for providing regenerative school meals for the next five years, and for helping build the farm that grows them. https://www.rockefellerfoundation.org

Thanks to our friends at Global Energy Alliance, this village now runs on solar — bringing light to every home, market and community space. https://energyalliance.org

190 trees were cut down to bring this village to life. Now we're working with Arbor Day Foundation, our longtime partners, to plant 250 new ones where they'll do the most good.
